title: GreenFault
description: Upgrade your gear. This pack refines vanilla tools and armor with high-quality textures and distinct, unique details while keeping the classic feel.
body:
# 💎 Features
- 🌟 Custom 3D totem
- 🛡️ Low shield
- 🗡️ Custom Sword
- 🔥 Low fire for better visibility
- 🔎 Small items for better PvP
- 🌌 Epic custom sky (Requires Mod)
- 💥 No explosion particles
- ✨ Better hit particles
- 🔮 Animated Ender Pearl
# ⚙ Technical Info
- 🏹 Version 1.21.9 - 26.1.2
- 🖼️ Resolution 16x
